---
title: "2 · From ranks to grades"
---

An ordered grade report states directions between grades and withholds comparisons within grades.
The [isolated-pair decision](one-pair.qmd) defines the relevant action costs, while the
[report construction example](report-builder.qmd) specifies the relations induced by complete grade assignments.
[Posterior reporting risk](price-of-silence.qmd) combines expected wrong directions and withholding cost.
The remaining applications examine coherence, the [error–disclosure frontier](frontier.qmd),
[report-family restrictions](families.qmd) and alternative error summaries. This framework also permits evaluation
of the [common rules](../rules/index.qmd) considered in Part 3.
